summary: Add parametric media, sandboxed custom visualizations, and source-grounded discussion tutor blocks to the existing lab registry, editor, preview and publication workflows.
rationale: D-011 authorizes isolated browser code execution and user-initiated hosted media under D-008. The existing role router, shared storage, immutable lab versions, assessment and assistance boundaries are preserved. Registry 2.0 and lab-discussion-v1 introduce new observable contracts; A-001 through A-006 remain unchanged.
authorization: Explicit user request in this task on 2026-09-20: Add this capabilities to labs: Embedded video/audio, arbitrary interactive visualizations, and an integrated discussion tutor. Make sure they are parametric so they are easy to insert in the lab. This authorizes these capabilities, not new model providers, server code execution, institutional submissions or altered scoring.
validation: 129 backend tests passed on SQLite, including 27 rich-block tests. Ruff and the architecture structural checker passed; skill frontmatter validation passed; Vite production build passed. Headless Chromium passed editor, preview (no learner writes/model calls), publication, parametric canvas rendering, native audio loading, tutor conversation, evidence and nested-frame isolation checks. The browser blocked parent DOM access, remote fetch and frame navigation; escaped data could not break out of the script. Mock tutor and disposable data only; no live model call was made. Local server was restarted after confirming no active jobs/calls; MCP now returns registry 2.0 with all three new blocks and the discussion schema. No remote publication or protections changed. Committed-diff coverage was not run because pre-existing work remains uncommitted; the checker result does not establish human approval or scientific correctness.
rollback: Revert only this change and restore earlier presentations through new lab revisions. Retain all lab versions, discussion/request records and evidence; no migration or database reset is required. Old renderers cannot display the new blocks. Work is on codex/rich-lab-blocks and pre-existing uncommitted work is preserved. No remote protections or deployment settings were changed. A coherent local snapshot was saved at data/before-rich-labs-20260920.zip before restarting the local service; it is ignored by Git and should not replace newer learner evidence.
